note: Chickasaw County Conservation Board's largest park, south of Fredericksburg, on a 7-acre lake. The campground is a grassy loop inside the park's south entrance, with the swimming beach, playground and volleyball court between it and the lake. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $20 electric ($15 non-electric, not listed online), 50 amp (some 30), water-fill only, showers/dump; added 25 sites, the May 1-Oct 15 season. Booking corrected reservable/phone/some_sites -> not reservable, first come (every site is 'Pay on Site'). Lakeview kept (open lawn and day use between loop and lake). Note's $18/$12 and reservation claim removed.
flags: BOOKING CORRECTION: the old note said the camping loop 'can be reserved by calling the CB office at least two weeks ahead'. No page read says so: every Split Rock campsite on MyCountyParks is 'only available for Pay on Site', and the county page says general campsites are first come, first served (its MyCountyParks reservation line and the '$110/day' camping loop belong to Airport Lake Park). Written as reservable false / fcfs always.

WATERFRONT: lakeview kept. NAIP (0.89 m/px): the campground is a gravel loop on open mown ground east of the 7-acre lake (over the 5-acre pond line, and the county calls it a lake). The nearest pads, at the loop's north-west end, are ~70-110 m from the water across open lawn that holds the swimming beach, a shelter, playground and volleyball court plus the park road to the beach; open ground with the lake visible earns the view, the day use and road block on-water.
PIN: stored 42.90920,-92.23780 is in the woodlot west of the campground, ~170 m from the loop's centre (~42.9093,-92.2357). Under the 250 m line; re-pin optional.
FIT: the sites are grassy back-ins with no posted length; visible units on imagery include trailers of 25 ft+. No doubt worth a caveat.
PHONE 641-394-4714 confirmed (park page 'Phone: 641-394-4714'; the county page's conservation board office).
